Title: TASK COST, ATTEMPT & ESCALATION HISTORY UI
Summary: An operator-facing TASK COST, ATTEMPT & ESCALATION HISTORY UI for the existing DevBridge AI subsystem. For any task the operator can see the COMPLETE AI execution history across attempts, retries, corrections, escalations, provider failures, model-quality failures, budget decisions and verification outcomes: WHAT WAS TRIED (ordered attempt timeline: provider, model, reasoning), WHY DID IT FAIL (failure category + failure fingerprint + verification), WHY DID DEVBRIDGE RETRY OR ESCALATE (transition arrows carrying the DB-M20 action + reason codes + explanation), HOW MUCH DID EACH ATTEMPT COST (per-attempt actual vs estimated), WHAT WAS THE TOTAL COST (task total actual + total estimated), and WHICH ATTEMPT FINALLY PASSED VERIFICATION (terminal VERIFIED_SUCCESS marker). DB-M29 is a PURE presentation engine: it takes AiAttemptRecord v1 (DB-M17) + optional DB-M20 EscalationDecisions + DB-M21 FailureFingerprints + DB-M22 ProviderHealthEvidence and returns a TaskHistoryView v1. NO persistence and NO second attempt-history database: the DB-M17 attempt store is consumed READ-ONLY and the EMPTY on-disk store renders an honest empty state ('No attempt history recorded.') rather than invented history. The engine never recomputes a cost formula (DB-M16 authority via Resolve-DbM25RecordCost, actual preferred / estimated labelled / cumulative), never writes an attempt/escalation/budget/fingerprint record, never executes a provider, never makes a paid API call, never makes a network call, and AUTO_EXECUTION_ENABLED=FALSE. DB-M29 reuses (does NOT rebuild) DB-M14..M28 READ-ONLY: DB-M14 route/health vocabularies, DB-M16 cost semantics, DB-M17 attempt store (the ONLY history source), DB-M19 routing eligibility vocabulary (NOT invoked, history is display only), DB-M20 New-EscalationChain + EscalationDecision/Input contracts + action/reason vocabularies (the timeline's WHY-RETRY/ESCALATE evidence), DB-M21 budget decision vocab + FailureFingerprint v1 (fingerprint + budget-stop evidence), DB-M22 ProviderHealthEvidence (optional provider-failure context, never a health-write), DB-M23 price-status + route identity (GatewayProviderId vs UnderlyingModelId never collapsed), DB-M24 Resolve-AiTaskChains/Resolve-AiChainFacts (task grouping, chain ordering, task facts), DB-M25 Resolve-DbM25VerifiedSuccess + Resolve-DbM25RecordCost (authoritative verified-success + cost resolution), DB-M26 aggregate dashboard (DB-M29 is the per-task drilldown, not a duplicate analytics), DB-M27/DB-M28 renderer + ReadOnlyGuard + secret-leak guard + markers pattern. TASK HISTORY VIEW carries the brief's fields: Task ID, Change ID, Mode, Attempt count, Total actual cost, Total estimated cost, Verified-success state (VERIFIED_SUCCESS/CONTRADICTED/MODEL_RETURNED/INCOMPLETE/NO_ATTEMPTS), First-attempt success YES/NO/UNKNOWN, Final model/provider (+ underlying/gateway identity), Corrections count, Escalations count, Failure count. The attempt timeline shows transition arrows (RETRY / RETRY_SAME_MODEL_HIGHER_REASONING / SWITCH_MODEL / SWITCH_PROVIDER_ROUTE / REBUILD_CONTEXT / CORRECTION / CORRECTION_CLAUDE_REVIEW_FIX) and terminal markers (BUDGET_STOP / HUMAN_REVIEW / GOVERNANCE_STOP / VERIFIED_SUCCESS / FAILED_NO_RETRY). S1-S55: UI opens + honest empty store, 13 task-row fields, attempt/total/cumulative cost, verified-success/contradicted/model-returned, first-attempt success, final model/provider, corrections/escalations/failure counts, timeline ordering + node fields, transition typing + DB-M20 decision carried, budget/human/governance/verified/no-retry terminals, failure category (DB-M17/DB-M20 vocab), fingerprint display, provider-failure evidence (read-only), route identity preserved, task filtering + sorting, cost authority (no formula re-implemented), no second attempt-history database, secrets never rendered/logged, no AI execution, paid calls 0, network calls 0, escalation/budget stores untouched, canonical workbook byte-identical, Nexus source unchanged, Lane C UI byte-identical, solution build 0 errors, frozen files/config/workbook SHA-256 byte-identical.
